parsed.rationale_overall: System A provides more thorough personalization by tying recommendations to specific profile attributes (income surplus math, dual goals, tax bracket) and includes better-grounded, more actionable steps like specific contribution amounts aligned to the user's $61K surplus. System B has some questionable claims (e.g., liquidating 35% of net worth into a 529, assuming BND placement without account info) and a less realistic dividend strategy, making A the stronger overall set.
